# opencode-tool-drop Permission-aware tool schema filter for [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai). Strips tools an agent's `permissions` deny out of the tool schema before it reaches the model — smaller payloads, faster first tokens, and an audit line per request. ```mermaid flowchart LR A[agent permissions
deny rules] --> C[tool-drop hook] B[session context
tools map] --> C C -->|"dropped: subagent, compress, ..."| D[model request
smaller schema] C --> E[~/.local/state/opencode/
tool-drop.log] ``` ## Why Every tool's JSON schema ships with every model request. Tools an agent is denied never help and always cost: | Agent setup | Tools | Schema | First turn (cold) | |---|---|---|---| | no deny rules | 27 | ~25 KB ≈ 6.3k tokens | ~6.4 min on a local model | | 6 deny rules | 24 | ~20 KB ≈ 5.0k tokens | ~4 min | `tool-drop` makes the cut explicit and observable: it reads the deny list, drops matching tools from the schema, and logs what it did — so you can see exactly which tools each agent was offered. ## Install npx + GitHub (no clone needed): ```bash npx opencode@latest plugin add github:abdullah1116/opencode-tool-drop ``` Or with the OpenCode CLI directly: ```bash opencode plugin add github:abdullah1116/opencode-tool-drop ``` Track the `main` branch for auto-updates (checked at startup and every 24 h): ```bash opencode plugin add github:abdullah1116/opencode-tool-drop#main ``` Or add it manually to `opencode.json`: ```json { "plugin": ["github:abdullah1116/opencode-tool-drop#main"] } ``` Local development: ```bash git clone git@github.com:abdullah1116/opencode-tool-drop.git opencode plugin add ./opencode-tool-drop ``` > Requires OpenCode with package-plugin support (`opencode plugin add`). Changes under watched config directories reload automatically. ## How it works ```mermaid flowchart TD S[session.hook: context · compaction · generate] --> L[read agent list
all agents, refreshed every 30s] L --> K{agent in
TOOL_DROP_SKIP_AGENTS?} K -->|yes| N[leave request untouched] K --> M[match this agent's deny rules
with * wildcards] M --> F[filter event.tools
drop denied names] F --> G[log: agent · perms · deny · tools · dropped] G --> Z[return] E1[any error] --> X[fail open: log + return untouched] ``` **No agent is hardcoded.** Every agent returned by `ctx.agent.list()` is processed; the active agent comes from the hook event, and its deny rules come from that agent's own `permissions`. - Hooks: `context`, `compaction`, `generate` (where the tools map is built) - Agent lookup: `ctx.agent.list()`, cached 30 s, refreshed on a timer - Matching: permissions are an **ordered list — last match wins** (a `*` deny first, then specific allows, keeps only the allowed tools). Only tool-wide rules — `resource: "*"` or no resource — affect the schema; a resource-scoped rule (e.g. `read:src/**`) leaves tool presence untouched. Wildcards work in both fields (`compress`, `chronicler_*`). - **Fail-open**: every hook body is wrapped — a failure logs and returns the request untouched, never kills the model call - If OpenCode already removed a denied tool upstream, the log shows `dropped=none` — the filter is a safety net, not a bypass ## Log One line per request: ``` ~/.local/state/opencode/tool-drop.log 2026-11-24T21:38:00Z setup start options={} skip=none log=... 2026-11-24T21:38:03Z hook agent=builder tools=24 patterns=compress|subagent dropped=compress ``` Rotate or delete it freely; it is recreated on demand. ## Environment variables | Variable | Default | Effect | |---|---|---| | `TOOL_DROP_SKIP_AGENTS` | *(empty)* | Comma-separated agent ids (or `*` globs) the plugin ignores entirely — e.g. `TOOL_DROP_SKIP_AGENTS=explore,plan*` | | `TOOL_DROP_LOG` | `$XDG_STATE_HOME/opencode/tool-drop.log` | Log file path | | `XDG_STATE_HOME` | `~/.local/state` | Base directory for the default log | Skipped agents are logged once per request as `skipped(SKIP_AGENTS)` so exclusions stay visible. ## Plugin options Extra deny patterns per agent, in the plugin entry of `opencode.json`: ```json { "package": "github:abdullah1116/opencode-tool-drop", "options": { "block": { "builder": ["git-push-*"] } } } ``` Options are merged with the agent's own `permissions` deny rules. ## Configure deny rules Per agent, in `opencode.json`: ```json { "agent": { "qwen-local": { "permissions": [ { "action": "subagent", "resource": "*", "effect": "deny" }, { "action": "compress", "resource": "*", "effect": "deny" } ] } } } ``` `tool-drop` picks these up automatically — no plugin config of its own. ## License MIT — Copyright (c) 2026 Abdullah Hasan.
